hlg_d8e5259c55bea167_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Create and distribute event invitations by configuring event details, generating unique cryptographically secure invitation codes for guests, and automatically sending those codes via email.
hlg_d8e5259c55bea167_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to configure event details including name, date, location, and budget; llg_002 adds the capability to generate unique, cryptographically secure invitation codes per guest; llg_003 adds the capability to automatically distribute those codes via email to guests’ registered email addresses.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Generate unique invitation codes for guests

hlg_dc05a6a00e807452_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to browse, filter, select, and book event services based on category, price, and availability.
hlg_dc05a6a00e807452_001.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to browse and select event services by filtering on category, price, and availability, and to initiate booking. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal encompasses only this single capability without adding or omitting any detail.

hlg_bba1d36093273738_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to publish, categorize, and tag their offerings for discoverability and availability on the platform.
hlg_bba1d36093273738_001.rationale: llg_001 enables service providers to publish service offerings by uploading details such as description, pricing, and availability; llg_002 enables them to categorize and tag services to enhance discoverability by event organizers. Together, these capabilities form a complete scope for service publication and metadata management, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

hlg_94df30668f000172_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide a complete service lifecycle for event organizers, including responding to appointment requests, generating and sending quotations, and confirming payment receipt for completed services.
hlg_94df30668f000172_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to respond to appointment requests by accepting or declining them via the platform. llg_002 adds the capability to generate and send quotations with pricing and terms to event organizers. llg_003 adds the capability to confirm payment receipt after service completion, marking the service as done. These three distinct lifecycle phases — request handling, quotation generation, and payment confirmation — are all required and must be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve their material differences and avoid generalization.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Confirm payment receipt for completed services

hlg_57dbb1d19d575603_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to securely access and view event-related content, including blogs and photos, by authenticating via an invitation code.
hlg_57dbb1d19d575603_001.rationale: llg_001 enables secure access to event content using an invitation code, which is the authentication mechanism. llg_002 extends this by allowing the guest to view specific content types (blogs and photos) after authentication. Together, they define a complete scope: secure access via invitation code and subsequent viewing of event blogs and photos — no other capabilities are implied or inferred.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Access event content using invitation code

hlg_d4bd8d89225ca214_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to contribute content, media, and feedback to an event blog through posting, uploading, and commenting.
hlg_d4bd8d89225ca214_001.rationale: llg_001 enables content submission (posting blog posts or media), llg_002 enables media uploading (images or videos), and llg_003 enables interaction (commenting on posts). Together, they cover the full scope of content contribution and engagement via the event blog, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_e2c0b7b29ea3a654_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to view and manage contract history while simultaneously monitoring the remaining event budget to ensure financial accountability and operational oversight.
hlg_e2c0b7b29ea3a654_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the event organizer to view and manage contract history, including status, cost, and completion details, which supports historical tracking and contractual accountability. llg_002 enables the organizer to view the remaining event budget after accounting for all booked services and expenses, which supports real-time financial monitoring. Together, these capabilities form a dual-track system: one for contract lifecycle visibility and one for budgetary control — no other capability is implied or inferred, and both are explicitly preserved.
